description.value: Fable Diner is an East Vancouver original established in 2016 inside the historic Lee Building at the busy Main & Broadway intersection in Mount Pleasant. Featured on Food Network's Diners Drive-Ins and Dives (Season 29, Episode 17), the diner is celebrated for creative comfort food built on locally sourced ingredients, with signature dishes like the Duck Pancake with kimchi. It is a well-rooted neighbourhood institution offering full table service, weekend brunch, and online ordering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Fable Diner website confirms the OSM address (151 E Broadway, Vancouver, BC V5T 1W1), phone ((604) 563-3463), and provides detailed menu and about content. An 'Order Online' navigation item confirms takeout service, and the brunch menu explicitly states 'Gluten free buns, bread and english muffins available for substitution' with veggie patty substitution also listed. No bike parking, bike rack, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging information appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Broadway is currently closed to vehicle traffic between Main and Quebec Streets for construction (noted on the website front page); the business states it remains open and accessible.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established full-service diner at a prominent Vancouver cycling corridor intersection with confirmed online ordering and GF options; a practical and notable meal stop for touring cyclists.
